title: the saved file differs from the draft in the one status scalar: comments, quotes, spacing, a trailing comment, blank lines and the word draft elsewhere stay byte for byte
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and B3-18/B3-19 (a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK: a terminal, or the token of the content he read; the guard denies the agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). The written content is the draft bytes with the status value `draft` replaced by `approved`: the position is taken from the YAML node, so a trailing comment on the status line, a single or double quoted value (the quotes stay), a quoted key, extra spaces, a comment and blank lines at the end of the file, and the word `draft` or `status` inside another value are all kept exactly as written. The oracle has no `build save` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs the `+ ` lines, the token text or the written file FAILS on it.
